summary: Client defaults and Response.json() behavior contradict the README.

findings.title: Default timeout is 5s, README says 30s
findings.suggested_fix: Change DEFAULT_TIMEOUT to 30.0 or update README.

findings.title: Response.json() is not always available
findings.evidence: README claims `.json()` always available; implementation raises unless content-type is JSON.
findings.suggested_fix: Document the content-type guard or make json() best-effort.
